metadata.disambiguation: Not to be confused with Saravali village in Greece

author_details.name: Kalyana Varma
author_details.title: King-astrologer
author_details.period: Between Varahamihira and Bhattotpala (7th century CE)
author_details.description: A renowned, pious, liberal and learned king of a region named Vyaghrapadi

significance.historical_importance: One of the most authoritative works on Hindu astrology
influence: Bhattotpala (9th century) quoted extensively from Saravali in his commentaries on Varahamihira's Brhat Samhita and Brhajjataka
Vaidyanatha Dikshita's Jatakaparjata is an epitome of this great work
Balabhadra embodied nearly one half of Saravali in his Horaratna
Mallinatha, the celebrated commentator, mentioned Kalyanavarman and Varahamihira giving quotations from Saravali
Mantreswara of Phala Deepika acknowledged reliance on Saravali

core_topics: Effects of planetary states at birth
Various developments of embryo in the womb
Dispositions of planets to cause and counter-act evils
Effects of a planet remaining in various signs aspected by another planet
Effects of various houses in aspect to the planets

chapter_highlights.chapters_27_to_29: Effects of Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in various signs and various aspects
chapter_highlights.chapter_30: Results of planets from Sun to Saturn placed in the 12 houses individually
chapter_highlights.chapter_32: Ninth house with special importance to Jupiter
chapter_highlights.chapters_41_to_44: Dasa calculations and effects of periods
chapter_highlights.chapter_45: Planetary dignities: exaltation, debilitation, own house

characteristics: Large and reddish nails, eyes, hands and legs
bilious.dreams: Gold, sun, lamp, engulfing fire, pink lotus, eunuch, blood, lightning

phlegmatic.dreams: Oceans, rivers, tanks, pearls, swans, white lotus, conch, lily, moon, iceberg

malavya.rule: Laata, Mala, Sindhu and Pariyatra regions

ruchaka.special_marks: Bed, rope, ox, arch, wheel, lute on palms and soles
ruchaka.rule: Cities between Vindhya and Sahya mountains

characteristics: Interested in wandering in forests, mountains, forts

svastha.effects: Acquires gold, family; justice in king's employ; owns houses; amasses grains; family prospers

mudita.effects: Pleasingly disposed; wife, gold, diamonds; wins foes; enjoys all comforts

santa.effects: Peaceful mind; comfort and wealth; king's minister; learned; helpful; religious; fortunate

sakta.effects: Wife, clothes, scents, garlands; famous; liked by all; name spread all-over

pidita.effects: Grief and sickness; enemies; deprived of own people; wanders from country to country

bhita.effects: Troubled by enemies; loses men; defeated; becomes poor

vikala.effects: Deprived of place or position; dirty-hearted; poor; wanders; frightened by enemies

khalavastha.effects: Grieves in sorrow; cannot maintain wife; loses wealth; impure mind; never free from miseries

exaltation.effects: All kinds of wealth; auspicious results to full extent

own_house.strength: Nominal if aspected by friendly planet

friendly_house.effects: Fame, splendour, abundant good fortune, long-lasting wealth, wealth through king

retrograde_in_exaltation.effects: Produces no effect; nothing good will happen

limbs_of_kalapurusha.Libra: Space below navel and private parts

rasi_descriptions.Aquarius: Resembles a man holding a pot
rasi_descriptions.Gemini: Compared to a couple holding Veena and mace
rasi_descriptions.Pisces: Imagination of a pair of fish
rasi_descriptions.Sagittarius: Man having a hip like that of a horse and holding an arch
rasi_descriptions.Virgo: Virgin sitting in a boat with a lamp in her hands
rasi_descriptions.Libra: Male holding Scales in his hand

disambiguation.note: Saravali also refers to a village in Greece

greek_village.name: Saravali (Σαράβαλι)
greek_village.history: Castle built by Franks in 13th century; battle of Greek War of Independence in 1822

legacy.impact: A shining but never setting star in the astral skies
legacy.reputation: Its authority on astrological points was undisputedly acknowledged in ancient times
legacy.style: Chaste and flowing; information more copious and valuable than any current astrological work
